verdict.rationale: First-party docs say that when computer use is enabled in Cowork, Claude can navigate your screen directly, clicking, typing and opening apps just like you would, to complete multi-step tasks. The built-in Cowork browser and the Claude in Chrome extension add the ability to read, click and fill forms on the web. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of computer use, detail on how Claude sees the screen and on permissions or safety controls, and platform and plan availability (the snippets also present computer use as a fallback used only when no connector exists).
